items.desc: The prime minister is scheduled to meet UN Secretary-General António Guterres and attend a reception hosted by Nepal’s mission.

items.title: NEA working on winter power management
items.desc: Officials say there won’t be load-shedding this winter despite flood damage to hydropower infrastructure along Trishuli corridor.

items.title: From a rented room in Bauddha to the Asian Games podium
items.desc: Karateka Tenzing Sherpa, 23, overcomes a difficult start, a semifinal defeat and his short temper to dominate Laos’s Xayasan Vatthana and secure Nepal’s first medal of the 20th Asian Games.

items.title: Avoid long-distance travel from Friday to Sunday, suspend Himalayan treks: Met office
items.desc: Weather experts urge trekkers already in the mountains to return to safer, lower elevations and ask the public to take precautions.

items.title: Kathmandu University founding vice-chancellor Suresh Raj Sharma dies
items.desc: Sharma, 86, played a key role in the development of technical and higher education in Nepal.

items.title: Flydubai begins regular international flights from Pokhara
items.desc: The daily Dubai-Pokhara service opens a new international air link for the tourism hub, with passengers also able to connect to more than 250 cities through Dubai.

items.title: How Nepal can lead the global climate charge at UNGA 81 and beyond
items.desc: From building global alliances at UNGA 81 to rallying vulnerable nations for COP31, former assistant secretary-general of the UN outlines a roadmap for urgent climate action and financing.

items.title: BP Highway to close at night in Kavrepalanchok from September 24 to 28 amid flood risk
items.desc: Authorities will stop vehicles from using the highway from 5 pm to 5 am, while the weather office has urged people to postpone long-distance travel from September 25 to 27.

items.title: AI leaders to brief UN amid warnings the technology could slip beyond human control
items.desc: Altman plans to urge world leaders to adopt benchmarks for measuring AI capabilities and ​assessing the safeguards companies put in place as they develop the technology, an OpenAI executive told reporters on Tuesday.

items.title: Kali Gandaki river settlements face rising flood risk
items.desc: Around a dozen settlements along the river are exposed to sudden flooding, while authorities assess the threat from landslides and glacial hazards.

items.title: Seven decades of Nepal at the UN: From Chuda Prasad Sharma to KP Oli
items.desc: From non-alignment and the concerns of small states to peace, development and climate justice, Nepal’s priorities at the UN General Assembly have evolved with the country’s politics and global challenges.

items.title: Death toll from capsized ship in Indonesia rises to 26 as search continues for 109 missing passengers
items.desc: Divers managed to break the windows of the cabins on Tuesday but could not enter due to murky water and strong currents, making it impossible to retrieve bodies that had already been spotted.

items.title: Bhotekoshi floods prompt ADB to cut Nepal’s growth forecast to 4.1 percent
items.desc: The Asian Development Bank has raised its inflation forecast to 5.3 percent and expects the fiscal deficit to widen as reconstruction spending increases following the devastation.

items.title: Helicopters put on standby as heavy rain forecast
items.desc: The Air Service Operators Association has directed its member companies to remain ready for possible rescue operations as heavy rain is forecast across Nepal from Thursday.

items.title: What kind of international environment is China trying to build?
items.desc: Nepal-China relations can advance simultaneously across development, connectivity, technology, trade, tourism, education, disaster management, multilateral diplomacy, and global governance.

items.title: Hydropower producers seek changes to proposed IPO rules
items.desc: Producers say the proposed eligibility framework does not reflect the financing needs and development cycle of hydropower projects.

items.title: Nepal, Malaysia renew three-year deal on migrant worker rights
items.desc: Pact targets forced labour, recruitment fees and rights violations as Malaysia reports 46 complaints involving Nepali workers.

items.title: Over 800 people remain missing from hydropower projects after Bhotekoshi floods, says energy minister Shrestha
items.desc: Shrestha tells Parliament that search and rescue teams are still looking for workers believed to be trapped in underground structures or swept away by the August 26 disaster.

items.title: Tenzing Sherpa wins Nepal’s first medal at Asian Games
items.desc: Karateka beats Laos’ Xayasan Vatthana 9-1 in repechage to secure bronze in men’s kumite +84kg category.

items.title: Indra Jatra opens with ceremonial pole raised at Hanumandhoka
items.desc: The eight-day festival began with the traditional erection of the Indra flagpole, marking the start of celebrations honouring the god of rain and prosperity.

items.title: Guterres recalls Nepal glacier warning as climate risks grow
items.desc: The UN chief said the impacts of climate change are arriving sooner and hitting harder, calling for more adaptation finance and a stronger Loss and Damage Fund as Nepal seeks international support after the August floods.

items.title: Flood destroys equipment, pushing back Siddhababa tunnel opening
items.desc: Replacement electromechanical equipment must be brought through the Korala border, delaying the planned start of traffic by at least a month.

items.title: Trump threatens to annihilate Iran as diplomats push for deal at UN
items.desc: Washington and Tehran seek a way out of the nearly seven-month war as Gulf states push for de-escalation and reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Khanal holds multiple diplomatic meetings in New York as Nepal establishes ties with Grenada
items.desc: The foreign minister discusses flood recovery, development cooperation and stronger economic ties with his Indian counterpart, US officials and other foreign ministers during the UN General Assembly sidelines.

items.title: US announces additional $31 million support for Nepal’s flood recovery
items.desc: The package includes funding for permanent bridges, humanitarian assistance and US-made drones, taking Washington’s total flood response and recovery support to more than $36 million.

items.title: Five films that show what growing up can mean
items.desc: Growing up looks different for everyone. These films explore adolescence, loss, responsibility, identity, and the difficult process of finding your place in the world.

items.title: Can Tenzing Sherpa save Nepal from an empty-handed karate campaign?
items.desc: With eight karatekas, including star Arika Gurung and a kata team, eliminated in Nagoya, Sherpa remains Nepal’s sole hope to avoid a medal drought. He faces Macau’s On Tek Leong in the quarterfinal today.

items.title: World number 3 Chandra Bahadur loses his first bout
items.desc: He becomes the third Nepali boxer to fail to progress from the preliminaries. Four Nepali boxers are yet to face their opponents across different weight categories.

items.title: Nepal women’s kabaddi team edges Thailand, men’s team crashes out
items.desc: The women’s team rallied from nine down to beat Thailand 46-43 in Nagoya, while three group-stage losses ended the men’s medal hopes with a match still in hand.

items.title: Nepal, India agree to review treaty amid widening trade deficit
items.desc: Experts call for changes to non-tariff barriers, reciprocal duty-free provisions, trade facilitation and investment as Nepal’s exports remain heavily dependent on a few products.
